messages:
rachel: Heads up — after promoting the 562.x driver image from image-builder to canary we see ~3% of GPU nodes in us-central stuck in an initramfs loop during boot. Some OOB provisioning attempts also time out.

ashok: Confirming. DKMS rebuild is failing on kernel 6.5.18 in the cloud images. `dkms` exits with unresolved symbol errors from the nvidia modules.

kevin: Paste of the short journal output I grabbed from one affected instance:
```
[   10.234567] nvidia: module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing - tainting kernel
[   10.235001] nvidia-drm: disagrees about version of symbol drm_release
[   10.235210] nvidia: Unknown symbol drm_release (err -22)
[   12.480123] dracut: Failed to mount /sys/module/nvidia/sections
[   12.480900] systemd-modules-load[1]: Failed to find module 'nvidia_drm'
```

ashok: `dkms status` shows the driver attempted to build against headers for both 6.5 and 6.1 but only 6.1 completed. On the failing nodes `dkms build` returns: `ERROR: Cannot find symbol table for module nvidia`

rachel: This cropped up during the staged rollout to us-central-1 on the image-bundle that includes CUDA 12.3 + driver 562.14. Canary had ~100 nodes, but the autoscaler created a few more for validation and those are the ones failing.

kevin: Quick mitigation options: 1) Pause further image promotions (done). 2) Quarantine failing nodes in the scheduler so jobs don't land on them (I tagged them `gpu:quarantine`). 3) Re-image a sample failing host with the previous image (driver 550.x) to validate rollback.

sre-lead: Agreed. Also need to update fleet agent to not attempt `dkms autoinstall` during firstboot while kernel modules are still being populated (race). That explains intermittent reconciling behavior where some nodes recover and others don't.

infra-ci-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1937 — "DKMS / initramfs boot loop after driver 562 rollout (us-central)". Assigned to @rachel and @ashok. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-1937

rachel: Quick repro notes for images team: the failing nodes were provisioned with `linux-headers-6.5.18` from our custom apt mirror. If you boot the image manually and run: `sudo dkms autoinstall --kernelsourcedir=/lib/modules/6.5.18`, you see the same unresolved symbol errors.

ashok: Temporary workaround that fixed one node in-place: purge new driver packages and reinstall 550 driver packages, then `update-initramfs -u` and reboot. `apt purge nvidia-driver-562* && apt install nvidia-driver-550` — node booted cleanly.

kevin: Fleet impact: ~22 GPU nodes unavailable in us-central across two ASGs. That's ~8% of our GPU capacity there (we're under high utilization this week). Autoscaler tried to spin up replacements but those hit the same image if not rolled back, so customers saw longer queue times.

rachel: Cost note — repeated reboots + reprovisioning is costing us an extra ~0.6 GPU-hours/hour while rollout is blocked. If this drags on more than a day we should evaluate emergency reserved capacity or divert traffic to europe-west to keep SLAs.

sre-lead: Action plan: 1) Revert image-builder tag for us-central to the previous manifest (done). 2) Run fleet job to re-image quarantined nodes to the 550-based image (in progress). 3) Postmortem: reproduce the DKMS symbol mismatch locally with kernel 6.5.18 and our build flags, capture exact linker map. 4) Add gating: full DKMS build + boot smoke in canary (require 5 successful boots).

ashok: One more datapoint — nodes with secureboot on were more likely to fail because module signatures were not present for the new driver variant; however we also saw unsigned-symbol mismatches on non-secureboot hosts, so it's not just signature checking.

kevin: Can someone check NCCL/ CUDA compatibility matrix? I want to ensure we're not mixing a CUDA runtime that assumes a different kernel ABI. Might be subtle with 12.3+ and kernel 6.5.

rachel: Will check. For now prioritize rollback + reimage so customer-facing queues stabilize. After that infra team will run reproduction matrix across kernels 6.1/6.4/6.5 with 550/562 drivers.

oncall-bot: @rachel @ashok — paging the kernel team and driver onboarding if not following already. Kernel-ticket: KRN-2026-482 created.

sre-lead: Thanks all. If anyone can spare time to help with the pre-check smoke scripts (small headless VM spin + boot + `nvidia-smi`) ping me. We need to harden rollout so a 3% failure doesn't cascade. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll help with the smoke harness and add a `modprobe -v nvidia_drm` check before tagging an image as promoted.

rachel: Closing the loop: rollback in us-central is complete for now, autoscaler is back to normal ramp, monitoring will watch for any stragglers. We'll run the postmortem and share findings in #eng-infra after root cause.

infra-ci-bot: Build artifact pinned to image-manifest:rm-2026-115 (driver 550.x) for us-central until PR #4123 lands with DKMS fixes.

kevin: TL;DR — Pause, quarantine, reimage to 550, and add DKMS+boot smoke to the canary gate.

rachel: Thank you all — follow-up doc request: please drop any logs and `dkms status` outputs into the incident ticket.
